WITH filtered_date_dim AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001 AND d_moy = 8
),
filtered_store_sales AS (
    SELECT ss_ticket_number, ss_item_sk, ss_sold_date_sk, ss_customer_sk, ss_store_sk
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN filtered_date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN (SELECT MIN(d_date_sk) FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001 AND d_moy = 8) AND (SELECT MAX(d_date_sk) FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001 AND d_moy = 8)
),
filtered_store_returns AS (
    SELECT sr_ticket_number, sr_item_sk, sr_returned_date_sk, sr_customer_sk
    FROM store_returns
    JOIN filtered_date_dim ON sr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN (SELECT MIN(d_date_sk) FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001 AND d_moy = 8) AND (SELECT MAX(d_date_sk) FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001 AND d_moy = 8)
)
SELECT s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip,
       SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "30 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 30) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 60) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "31-60 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 60) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 90) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "61-90 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 90) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "91-120 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days"
FROM store
JOIN filtered_store_sales ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
JOIN filtered_store_returns ON sr_ticket_number = ss_ticket_number AND sr_item_sk = ss_item_sk
GROUP BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip
ORDER BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip
LIMIT 100
